title: Cockpit
pitch: A live dashboard on a light datasheet: global condition sliders recompute every tile, and each tile opens a drawer with Summary, Evidence and Derivation.
bestFor: Quantitative decisions with a live model, where readers change assumptions and check one number's derivation at a time (build-vs-buy, pricing, capacity planning, business cases).
weakness: No linear narrative: an argument meant to be read top to bottom gets scattered across tiles and drawers, and prose-heavy blocks feel cramped as tiles.
signals: a model with 3–6 inputs the reader would change
several headline numbers (KPIs) that move together
comparison of options on cost or capacity
avoid: no quantitative model or headline numbers
an essay or argument to read in order
a story that depends on time or sequence
